Applesauce (the iOS port of touchHLE/HyperHLE) with the fixes **Skate It** (EA, v1.0.70) needs, set up to start the game directly.

The game is **not included**. Bring your own decrypted copy.

## What's new

- **Skate It is playable.** The main thread's stack now leaves headroom at the top of memory, so the game's text, physics, models and menus work. Before, it had garbled text, the skater spawned inside the ground, and Career/Options couldn't be opened.
- **Starts the game directly.** Opening the app asks StikDebug to enable JIT if needed, then starts Skate It from `touchHLE_apps`. Exiting the game returns to the library.
- **New name and icon:** the app is now called *Skate It Fix* and has its own icon (original artwork, no EA material).

## Install (iOS 17.4 or newer)

1. Download `Applesauce-iOS-unsigned.ipa` below and sideload it with AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly (signed with your own Apple ID).
2. Set up StikDebug with its pairing file and LocalDevVPN.
3. Import your Skate It `.ipa`, or put it in **Files › On My iPhone › Skate It Fix › touchHLE_apps**.
4. Open the app.

JIT is required. A sideloaded app can't enable it by itself on iOS 17.4+, so StikDebug has to attach each time the app starts.

`Applesauce-iOS-unsigned.ipa.sha256` holds the SHA-256 checksum of the IPA.
